title: Fail closed inactive encoder selections
summary: Add a fail-closed encoder activation readiness gate before encode FFmpeg plan construction.
reason: Inactive cataloged encoders such as AV1, QSV, AMF, and CPU-primary x264/libaom paths should not fall into the legacy generic FFmpeg branch before descriptor-owned flags, fallback policy, command topology tests, and real-media validation are complete.
